sentences.en: They want to choose their mates by their own will.
sentences.zh: 他们想按照自己的意愿选择伴侣。

sentences.en: My uncommonly well-made sneaker lasted 5 years. Its mate did not.
sentences.zh: 我那双做工极佳的运动鞋穿了五年。它的另一半却早已不见。

sentences.en: Who the bloody hell do you think YOU are, mate?
